purpose: Create the first public release on Mythical Void's existing GitHub project so a visitor or search engine can find a dated, truthful statement that the game is playable now. The release leads to the owned Play doorway, uses no weak gameplay media, does not distribute a second build, and does not claim that a release view is a player or that GitHub will create discovery.

release.title: Mythical Void is playable now — Early Access

authority.authorityBasis: Kevin's continuing instruction to get Mythical Void known and playable, his standing autonomy instruction for owned growth work, and his earlier direction to get approved work live.

gates.name: No conflicting release or tag confirmed
No gameplay media or download attached
Release points to reviewed main commit

publicEvidence.title: Mythical Void is playable now — Early Access

measurementBoundary: A GitHub release view, reaction, download or repository visit is not a player, a completed game session, enjoyment, retention or recommendation. Public GitHub numbers and consented aggregate website events describe separate actions and cannot be joined into a person-level journey. No conversion rate, audience size or product-value claim may be inferred from them.
rollback: Delete the GitHub release and its tag if the wording, target, links or boundaries differ from this reviewed record. Removing a release cannot erase screenshots, quotes or cached copies made by others after publication.
nextDecision: Leave this release unchanged unless a factual error or broken owned link is found. Treat GitHub views as release-page interest only, never as players or successful sessions. Add gameplay media only after a person approves strong real-game moments. The higher-value next steps remain connecting Mythical Void to Google Search Console and completing the First Five adult play test; both require separate evidence and decisions.
